title: Deep Dive on AI Documentation: Live Demo with Omer Rosenbaum
description:
Join Simon Maple as he interviews Omer Rosenbaum, the CTO and founder of Swimm, in a fascinating discussion on leveraging AI to tackle the perennial challenges of code documentation. Omer shares insights into how Swimm uses static analysis and generative AI to keep documentation in sync with code changes, making it easier for developers to find and maintain relevant documentation. Through practical demonstrations, Omer illustrates how Swimm can be integrated into your development workflow to enhance onboarding, training, and overall code comprehension. Whether you're a developer or a product manager, this episode provides valuable insights into the future of code documentation.

Chapters:
00:20 Intro – Simon Maple introduces Omer Rosenbaum and the focus on AI in documentation.
01:42 What is Swimm? – Omer explains how Swimm helps teams understand code.
02:06 Live Swimm Demo – Walkthrough of adding a new Git CLI command with Swimm.
03:16 Discover Docs in Context – Showing Swimm’s feature for contextual documentation.
07:50 Auto-Sync with Code – How Swimm keeps docs updated with code changes.
08:39 GitHub & CI/CD Integration – Discussion on integrating Swimm with GitHub and pipelines.
13:52 Guided Doc Creation – Using AI for efficient documentation with Swimm.
16:23 AI Docs for Unknown Code – Demonstrating AI-generated docs for a COBOL repo.
25:26 AI vs. Human Validation – Importance of validating AI-generated documentation.
31:51 Getting Started – How to try Swimm’s free tier and enterprise options.
